lines.text: The great crowd at the feast heard Jesus was coming to Jerusalem and went out with palm branches.
The crowd shouted "Hosanna!" and called Jesus the King of Judah.
Jesus found a young donkey and sat on it, as written: "Do not be afraid, O Daughter of Zion."
The disciples first did not understand but later remembered, and people who were with Jesus at Lazarus's raising testified.
The Sadducees said to one another, "Look how the whole world has gone after Him!"
